SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_ddd5(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  class varchar(100) NOT NULL,
	mg  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg10  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg11  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg12  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg1  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg2  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg3  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg4  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg5  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg6  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg7  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg8  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	mg9  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	dd  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd10  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd11  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd12  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd1  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd2  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd3  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd4  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd5  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd6  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd7  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd8  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd9  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,class),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year),
	KEY (class)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_ddd5 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ddd5
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode,CONCAT(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
			,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,class
,SUM(a.mgTotal) mg
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(10), a.mgTotal,0)) mg10
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(11), a.mgTotal,0)) mg11
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(12), a.mgTotal,0)) mg12
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(1), a.mgTotal,0)) mg1
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(2), a.mgTotal,0)) mg2
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(3), a.mgTotal,0)) mg3
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(4), a.mgTotal,0)) mg4
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(5), a.mgTotal,0)) mg5
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(6), a.mgTotal,0)) mg6
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(7), a.mgTotal,0)) mg7
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(8), a.mgTotal,0)) mg8
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(9), a.mgTotal,0)) mg9
,SUM(a.mgTotal/a.P) dd
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(10), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd10
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(11), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd11
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(12), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd12
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(1), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd1
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(2), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd2
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(3), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd3
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(4), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd4
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(5), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd5
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(6), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd6
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(7), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd7
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(8), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd8
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') in(9), (a.mgTotal/a.P),0)) dd9
FROM s_1ddd_ipvisit o
				INNER JOIN chospital h ON o.hospcode=h.hoscode
				INNER JOIN t_ddd_ip a ON o.hospcode=a.hospcode
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(a.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND o.b_year=(@b_year+543)
GROUP BY h.hoscode,a.class
);
rows.indiv_sql:
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx IGNORE AS 
SELECT p.hospcode,p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA
,AN,DATETIME_ADMIT,DATETIME_DISCH,DIDSTD,DNAME
,WARDSTAY,TYPEDRUG,dsf,P,GenericName,Class,AMOUNT
,mgPerPackage,mgTotal
,IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,DATETIME_ADMIT,DATETIME_DISCH)=0,1,TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,DATETIME_ADMIT,DATETIME_DISCH)) as ACTLOS
FROM t_ddd_ip d INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON d.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND d.PID=p.PID
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(d.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d;

SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX, d.BIRTH
,d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA
,d.AN,d.DATETIME_ADMIT,d.DATETIME_DISCH,d.DIDSTD,DNAME
,d.WARDSTAY,d.TYPEDRUG,d.dsf,d.P,d.GenericName,d.Class,d.AMOUNT
,d.mgPerPackage,d.mgTotal,d.ACTLOS
FROM tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

SELECT c.class,w.P as ddds
,o.iday,mg,((dd*100)/o.iday) ddd
,o.iday10,mg10,((dd10*100)/o.iday10) ddd10
,o.iday11,mg11,((dd11*100)/o.iday11) ddd11
,o.iday12,mg12,((dd12*100)/o.iday12) ddd12
,o.iday1,mg1,((dd1*100)/o.iday1) ddd1
,o.iday2,mg2,((dd2*100)/o.iday2) ddd2
,o.iday3,mg3,((dd3*100)/o.iday3) ddd3
,o.iday4,mg4,((dd4*100)/o.iday4) ddd4
,o.iday5,mg5,((dd5*100)/o.iday5) ddd5
,o.iday6,mg6,((dd6*100)/o.iday6) ddd6
,o.iday7,mg7,((dd7*100)/o.iday7) ddd7
,o.iday8,mg8,((dd8*100)/o.iday8) ddd8
,o.iday9,mg9,((dd9*100)/o.iday9) ddd9
FROM catb_ddd c INNER JOIN cwho_ddd w ON c.DrugDDD_Mapping=w.DrugDDD_Mapping AND SUBSTR(c.DIDSTD19,17,1) IN(1)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT class, SUM(mg) mg,SUM(mg10) mg10,SUM(mg11) mg11,SUM(mg12) mg12
,SUM(mg1) mg1,SUM(mg2) mg2,SUM(mg3) mg3,SUM(mg4) mg4,SUM(mg5) mg5
,SUM(mg6) mg6,SUM(mg7) mg7,SUM(mg8) mg8,SUM(mg9) mg9
, SUM(dd) dd,SUM(dd10) dd10,SUM(dd11) dd11,SUM(dd12) dd12
,SUM(dd1) dd1,SUM(dd2) dd2,SUM(dd3) dd3,SUM(dd4) dd4,SUM(dd5) dd5
,SUM(dd6) dd6,SUM(dd7) dd7,SUM(dd8) dd8,SUM(dd9) dd9
FROM  {tablename}  {sjoin}
INNER JOIN chospital h ON {tablename}.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE  b_year= '{year}' {where} {hospcode} {cmihospcode} {DEP} {fzyymm}
GROUP BY class
) s ON  s.class=c.class
,(SELECT SUM(iday) iday,SUM(iday10) iday10,SUM(iday11) iday11,SUM(iday12) iday12 
,SUM(iday1) iday1,SUM(iday2) iday2,SUM(iday3) iday3,SUM(iday4) iday4,SUM(iday5) iday5
,SUM(iday6) iday6,SUM(iday7) iday7,SUM(iday8) iday8,SUM(iday9) iday9
FROM s_1ddd_ipvisit as {tablename}  {sjoin}
INNER JOIN chospital h ON {tablename}.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE b_year= '{year}' {where} {hospcode} {cmihospcode} {DEP} {fzyymm}
) AS o
GROUP BY c.class
ORDER BY  c.class
